_source: The host's favourites (their Spotify playlist), described from memory: the craft to learn from, never the tunes to copy.

songs.title: Halcyon + On + On
songs.sounds: a pitched-up, cut-up female vocal used as texture, a soft bubbling arpeggio, warm analogue pads, a light swinging groove
songs.signature: it never drops: layer after layer joins the same few chords until the whole thing glows
songs.borrow: build by accumulation, not by a drop: add one voice every few bars over an unchanging loop, and let a sung phrase become an instrument

songs.title: Lush 3-5 (C.J. Bolland)
songs.sounds: a rolling bassline, sharp synth stabs, hypnotic repeating sequences, dry hard drums
songs.signature: a melodic Orbital track remade as relentless, hypnotic techno
songs.borrow: take a lovely melodic idea and play it as a tool for the dancefloor: one short motif, repeated and filtered, over a driving bass

songs.title: It's a Fine Day
songs.tempo: around 120 BPM, a light rave-pop bounce
songs.sounds: an airy, high, breathy female vocal, a skipping breakbeat, bright piano stabs, a warm bass
songs.signature: a folk melody sung almost unaccompanied, set over rave drums: innocence over the beat
songs.borrow: a simple, singable, folk-like hook in a major key, high and floating above the rhythm with lots of air around it

songs.title: Children (Dream Version)
songs.sounds: a solo piano riff, a soft string pad, a steady kick with offbeat hats, a round bass
songs.signature: dream house: one plaintive piano riff carries the whole track, first alone, then over the beat
songs.borrow: give the hook to a plain piano and play it bare first, then bring the beat in under it: the melody alone is the drop

songs.title: Angels
songs.sounds: a clean, reverbed electric guitar, a hushed intimate vocal, almost no drums, deep silence between notes
songs.signature: restraint: very few notes and a lot of space, each one heard
songs.borrow: less is more: two or three parts at most, long rests, a melody of few notes, the silence as part of the arrangement

songs.title: Loud Places
songs.sounds: a soft, low, intimate vocal, a gentle house groove, steel-drum-like colour, a huge gospel choir in the chorus
songs.signature: a quiet, lonely verse that opens into a euphoric choir: the lift from intimate to communal
songs.borrow: a big contrast between sections: keep the verse small and close, then let the chorus open into a wide choir or massed voices

songs.title: One Love
songs.sounds: chopped, hard breakbeats, a reedy Middle-Eastern-sounding melodic sample, rave stabs, a heavy sub bass
songs.signature: an exotic, modal melody riding over hard, busy breaks
songs.borrow: a modal hook (phrygian colour, a flat second) played on a reedy, wind-like voice over a busy, chopped beat

songs.title: Sandstorm
songs.sounds: a single buzzy saw lead in relentless sixteenth notes, a pounding kick, filter sweeps, a siren-like rise
songs.signature: one rhythmic lead riff, almost one note, that moves up and down in blocks: rhythm as the hook
songs.borrow: a hook made of rhythm more than melody: a sixteenth-note lead on two or three notes, shifted up a step for tension, with the filter opening as the build

songs.title: K.I.S.S.E.S
songs.sounds: warm, kitschy vintage-sounding vocals and instruments, a soft loose beat, playful details
songs.signature: British chillout with a wink: old-fashioned sweetness made into something odd and warm
songs.borrow: a sweet, slightly retro, playful colour: a lounge-like voice or vintage keys, a little humour in the details

songs.title: Feather
songs.sounds: a looping jazz piano, a dusty swung hip-hop beat, warm bass, soft strings
songs.signature: a melancholy-but-hopeful jazz piano loop with seventh chords under a laid-back swing
songs.borrow: jazz harmony (sevenths and ninths) on a looping piano phrase, a swung beat with a lazy snare, warmth over polish

songs.title: Voodoo People
songs.sounds: a gritty, distorted riff, a flute-like phrase, hard breakbeats, a menacing bass
songs.signature: a dirty, repeating riff that is part rock, part rave, over relentless breaks
songs.borrow: a short, gritty, distorted riff as the hook, with an unexpected woodwind colour against it, and real menace in the bass

songs.title: Sonic Empire
songs.sounds: a huge synth anthem riff, a pounding four-to-the-floor kick, rave stabs, crowd-sized reverb
songs.signature: a Love Parade anthem: one big, simple riff made for a million people
songs.borrow: a big, simple anthem riff in a minor key that a crowd could chant, held back in the breakdown and returned at full size

songs.title: Not In Love
songs.sounds: bright, glassy chiptune-like arpeggios, a wistful, distant male vocal, a hard synthetic beat, washes of reverb
songs.signature: a melancholy pop song in cold, glittering electronics
songs.borrow: sad melody, bright cold sound: a glassy, fast arpeggio under a slow, aching lead

songs.title: What Else Is There?
songs.sounds: a dark, pulsing synth bass, an eerie, haunting female vocal, mournful strings, sparse, heavy drums
songs.signature: a slow-burning, cinematic darkness that grows without ever speeding up
songs.borrow: a brooding minor pulse that builds tension by adding strings and weight, never tempo; an eerie lead voice
